purpose: Response-blind schema qualification of Danish NOVANA marine eelgrass monitoring for external testing of the Tampa quantitative early-warning hypothesis.

source.public_description: Dataset contains all species from the marine eelgrass survey subject in VanDa and includes place, time, transect, measurement point, species, cover, main distribution and maximum depth limit.

hypothesis_boundary.endpoint: Among source-year repeated sampling units with recorded Zostera presence, predict next-year recorded loss at the same stable unit.
hypothesis_boundary.augmentation: source-year quantitative Zostera cover state only

stop_rule: If required schema roles cannot be mapped from response-independent schema/official metadata before GetFeature access, terminate v1 pre-response.
